input_contract.subject: A governed Revit project template or project aligned to a governed template release.
preconditions: The template/project is readable through an approved Revit API execution context.
Its governed template identity/release can be resolved or explicitly marked unresolved.

steps: Resolve the tested template identity and governed release context.
Enumerate required content classes including titleblocks, view templates, annotation styles, object/line styles, materials, phases, worksets where applicable, and governed parameters.
Compare the observed inventory to the governed content manifest and validation ruleset.
Record missing, obsolete, duplicate, unauthorized substitute, and unresolved content.
Map findings to ATS result states.
execution_contract.safety_boundary: Read-only. The checker shall not load, purge, rename, replace, or repair template content.
execution_contract.authority_boundary: The ETS verifies a governed template release; it cannot designate a template as approved or alter the Template Catalogue.

required_observations: finding records by content class and identifier

result_mapping.pass: The governed template identity is resolved and the complete applicable content manifest is satisfied without unauthorized substitutions.
result_mapping.fail: A complete applicable manifest exists and at least one required item is missing, obsolete, or replaced by unauthorized local content.
result_mapping.not_applicable: No governed Revit template applies to the tested context.
result_mapping.indeterminate: The governed Template Catalogue, content manifest, validation ruleset, or template identity is incomplete or unavailable.

provenance.migration_note: Appendix E Revit/ZEN ETS contract. It remains specification-only until concrete governed template catalogue/manifest data exists.
